jamal (SRE): :rotating_light: Getting an SLO burn alert for hosted-infer gateway — p99 5xx spike in us-west. Support has a live customer escalated for timeouts. Anyone seeing trace coverage or logs?

maria (oncall): I see the spike starting ~00:04 UTC, probe SLOs look fine but real traffic p99 jumps. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/dash/hosted-infer/gateway-5xx?from=now-30m

alan (infra): Quick look — upstream=\"inference-proxy\" returning a lot of `502 recv timeout`. Batcher backlog spiking, queue_time histogram shifted right. Could be a short lived GPU warmup/IO stall.

zoe (support): Customer report: \"requests intermittently return 502 Request timed out\" with retry storm. They pasted request ids: r12345,r12346. Their app retried 3x before surfacing error. Billing for that org doesn't show overage.

jamal (SRE): Copying repro I used:

```
for i in {1..200}; do 
  curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}\" -H \"X-Client-Id: acct-42\" \
    -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-1\",\"input\":\"hello\"}' \
    https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate &
done
```

Run at ~200 concurrent and watch `gateway.request.latency` and `gateway.response.status`. If you can repro please attach a trace id.

maria (oncall): Also seeing tracegap on many 502s — spans stop at the gateway, no downstream spans for a chunk of traces. Tracing agent logs show intermittent TLS handshake errors to the infer-host group. Query I ran: `logs | where status==502 | summarize count() by upstream, tls_error` (pseudo).

alan (infra): Not seeing authz failures in auth service. My hunch: prefetch/kvcache layer is getting overwhelmed and triggering downstream timeouts. If proxy hits busy worker pool, it returns 502. Increasing the proxy->worker request timeout might reduce customer-facing 502s but masks root backlog.

zoe (support): Customer wants ETA. They're on a mission-critical path. Can we fall back them to dedicated capacity or a cheaper model variant temporarily?

jamal (SRE): Short mitigation: 1) enable the fallback route for that org (route->dedicated-variant) 2) temporarily raise gateway upstream timeout from 6s -> 12s (risk: longer tail latencies) 3) add a short-term autoscale burst on workers for that pool. I'll open a deploy ticket if we agree.

alan (infra): I'll prepare a scaled-up worker pool and increase timeout by config flag. Will post PR and timeline.

maria (oncall): For postmortem / triage: save a sample of request ids, query logs for `trace_id` gaps, export a 15m window from observability. I'll start the raw logs grab: `es/queries: status:502, range: 00:03-00:10 UTC, upstream: inference-proxy`

zoe (support): Passing mitigation plan to customer now. They're ok with temporary fallback. I'll update the support ticket and ask for reproduction artifacts. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-03-16-724. SLO alert auto-acknowledged by jamal.

jamal (SRE): Follow-ups: - investigate TLS handshake failures on worker side - look for correlation with deployment/instance restarts - check kvcache eviction rates and prefetch latencies - add synthetic trace that hits realpath (not probe) for next 24h to catch mismatch

alan (infra): Will also bump worker log level to capture handshake stacks for next 30m, backoff if noise spikes.

maria (oncall): Marking thread as active. Will update when scaled pool is up and we've verified 5xx rate drops.

zoe (support): Thanks team, passing ETA to customer (30–45m).

jamal (SRE): :eyes: monitoring now, will post verification when p99 falls back below SLO."
